description: This Java source file defines the ContactOperations helper class for managing contact data entries within the Android platform's contact content provider. It includes methods for adding, updating, and batching contact information such as names, emails, phone numbers, avatars, group memberships, and profile actions, facilitating contact synchronization and manipulation in an Android app.

classes.name: ContactOperations
classes.description: A helper class for batching and applying modifications to contacts in the Android contact provider. It supports creating new contacts, updating existing ones, and adding various data types such as names, emails, phones, avatars, and profile actions, using batched content provider operations.

methods.name: createNewContact
methods.description: Creates a new contact with initial data, returning a ContactOperations instance for further modifications.

methods.name: updateExistingContact
methods.description: Creates a ContactOperations instance to update an existing contact identified by rawContactId.

methods.name: addName
methods.description: Adds a full name or first and last name to the contact being built.

methods.name: addEmail
methods.description: Adds an email address to the contact.

methods.name: addPhone
methods.description: Adds a phone number with specified type.

methods.name: addGroupMembership
methods.description: Adds the contact to a group identified by groupId.

methods.name: addAvatar
methods.description: Downloads an avatar from a URL and adds it to the contact.

methods.name: addProfileAction
methods.description: Adds a profile action linked to a specific userId.

methods.name: updateServerId
methods.description: Updates the server ID associated with a raw contact.

methods.name: updateEmail
methods.description: Updates an email address for an existing contact data row.

methods.name: updateName
methods.description: Updates the name information for a contact.

methods.name: updateDirtyFlag
methods.description: Marks a contact as dirty or clean.

methods.name: updatePhone
methods.description: Updates the phone number for a contact.

methods.name: updateAvatar
methods.description: Updates the avatar image for a contact.

methods.name: updateProfileAction
methods.description: Updates the profile action data for a contact.

methods.name: addInsertOp
methods.description: Adds an insert operation for contact data into the batch.

methods.name: addUpdateOp
methods.description: Adds an update operation to the batch.

methods.name: newInsertCpo
methods.description: Creates a new insert ContentProviderOperation with sync and yield parameters.

methods.name: newUpdateCpo
methods.description: Creates a new update ContentProviderOperation with sync and yield parameters.

methods.name: newDeleteCpo
methods.description: Creates a new delete ContentProviderOperation with sync and yield parameters.

methods.name: addCallerIsSyncAdapterParameter
methods.description: Adds the sync adapter parameter to a Uri if needed for permissions.
